subject: ACE registration confirmation & PDM/PSM pairing for CloudHorizon AWS co-sell
messages:
From: David Nguyen <david.nguyen@cloudhorizon.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS ACE registration & co-sell interest

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking the time on the call earlier — CloudHorizon is keen to pursue the AWS co-sell route and we want to get ACE registration started this week. High level: we’re a mid-market analytics vendor (Series B), target deployment for a pilot in Q3, and we’ll need PDM/PSM pairing for enablement and joint pipeline motion.

Can you confirm what information you need from us to complete ACE registration? I’ve attached a short MOP to this note (CloudHorizon-MOP-v1.pdf).

Quick answers to likely asks:
- AWS Opportunity ID: 002-CH-6291 (internal)
- Target launch window: late Sept (pilot)
- Primary technical contact: Priya Shah (cc)

Appreciate any guidance on next steps and whether we should loop AWS PDM now or wait until Redwood completes ACE intake.

Best,
David Nguyen
Head of Partnerships
CloudHorizon

Attachments: CloudHorizon-MOP-v1.pdf (PDF, 428 KB)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: David Nguyen <david.nguyen@cloudhorizon.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS ACE registration & co-sell interest

Hi David — thanks and great to see the MOP. I’ve reviewed the file and this looks like a good fit for ACE. Next steps (quick):

1) I need the AWS Opportunity ID (you provided 002-CH-6291 — I’ll confirm formatting with AWS).
2) We’ll submit the ACE registration form and request PDM/PSM pairing — I’ll CC our seller to start the handshake.
3) Please confirm the proposed pilot timeline and any specific compliance asks (SOC2, data residency).

Suggested mutual action plan (short):
- This week: Redwood submits ACE registration + PDM handshake
- Next week: Intro call with AWS PDM + Redwood PDM (30 mins)
- 2–3 weeks: Technical readiness checklist (security evidence, account mapping)
- Sept: Joint pilot launch (if readiness checks pass)

Can you confirm the AWS contact for the opportunity and attach any procurement docs you expect us to see? I’ll start the registration immediately.

Thanks — looping Ben to coordinate the handshake.

— Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0184

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: David Nguyen <david.nguyen@cloudhorizon.ai>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AWS ACE registration & co-sell interest — introducing PDM lead

Forwarding David's note and MOP.

Hi David — I’m Ben (seller on this oppty). Looping Laura Bennett (Redwood PDM) to coordinate PDM/PSM pairing and technical readiness. Laura — quick context below from CloudHorizon: pilot target late Sept, AWS Opportunity 002-CH-6291, primary tech contact Priya Shah.

Action items for internal team:
- Laura: can you lead the PDM intro to AWS and own the readiness checklist?
- Soojin: I’ll handle ACE submission and seller-side details with AWS account rep.

CloudHorizon — we’ll set a short 30-minute intro with AWS PDM once Laura confirms availability.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: CloudHorizon-Product-OnePager.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)

From: David Nguyen <david.nguyen@cloudhorizon.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudhorizon.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: AWS ACE registration & co-sell interest — introducing PDM lead

Thanks Ben and Soojin — and hi Laura.

We’ve pulled together the additional details you requested:
- AWS Opportunity formal ID (as shown in AWS): 002-CH-6291
- Procurement window: expecting PO by 2026-09-15 if pilot success
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II in place; we will provide attestation and a redacted network diagram for the readiness packet

I’m attaching a screenshot of the ACE intake page where we hit a permissions prompt (ACE-registration-screenshot.png). If Redwood can submit the registration on our behalf or advise which AWS role needs to approve, that would be helpful.

We’re available for a 30 min intro with AWS PDM next Wed (2026-07-08) morning PT.

— David

Attachments: ACE-registration-screenshot.png (PNG, 85 KB)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: David Nguyen <david.nguyen@cloudhorizon.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: aws-pdm@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS ACE registration & co-sell interest — PDM/PSM pairing and next steps

Hi all — Laura here (Redwood PDM). Thanks for the context, David — welcome. I’ll take point on pairing with AWS and coordinating Redwood’s readiness tasks. Proposed plan:

1) I’ll reach out to the AWS PDM contact (cc’d) to request a kick-off slot — suggested times: 2026-07-08 09:00–09:30 PT or 2026-07-08 10:00–10:30 PT. Please confirm availability.
2) I’ll assemble the readiness checklist items and create a shared Google Drive folder (I’ll paste link here when ready). Expected artifacts: SOC2 attestation, redacted architecture diagram, sample S3 ingest policy, and list of expected api flows.
3) I will also add a short runbook for the ACE submission — if CloudHorizon can grant the necessary AWS console permissions to a named AWS rep, that will unblock the intake.

Internal asks for Redwood: Ben — can you capture the exact AWS account/funding owner email so we can map accounts? Soojin — I’ll sync with you after the kick-off to prioritize technical actions.

Thanks — looking forward to the intro.

Laura Bennett
Platform Delivery Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
